items.headline: Stocks Fall as Oil Surges, Inflation Fears Mount
items.summary: U.S. stocks are broadly lower in mid-session trading as oil prices climb above $100 a barrel amid escalating U.S.-Iran tensions, intensifying inflation concerns. A hotter-than-expected Producer Price Index (PPI) report for August has further fueled expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike later this month, with probabilities now nearing 70%. The S&P 500, NASDAQ, and Dow Jones Industrial Average all saw declines in early trading.

items.headline: August PPI Exceeds Expectations, Bolstering Rate Hike Odds
items.summary: The Producer Price Index (PPI) for August rose 0.4% month-over-month, matching estimates, but wholesale prices climbed 5.4% from a year earlier, slightly above expectations. Core PPI, excluding volatile items, increased to 4.6% year-on-year, up from 4.3%. This firmer-than-expected inflation data has pushed the probability of a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike at the September 16 FOMC meeting to nearly 70%.

items.headline: Existing Home Sales Decline in August
items.summary: Sales of previously owned homes fell by 2% in August from July, reaching a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 3.98 million units. This marks the lowest sales pace since June 2025.

items.headline: Oil Prices Surge Above $100 Amid Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: Brent crude prices have surged above $100 a barrel, with WTI crude near $97.40, as escalating U.S.-Iran conflict raises concerns about Middle East energy supplies. This surge is a key factor driving current inflation fears and market downturn.

items.headline: Energy Sector Continues to Lead as Other Sectors Lag
items.summary: The Energy sector advanced 1.1% on Wednesday, continuing its strong performance. Oil/Energy earnings are projected to lead for the full year 2026 with 78.9% growth. Conversely, Industrials, Consumer Discretionary, and Utilities sectors lagged, declining 1.5%, 1.2%, and 1.1% respectively yesterday.

items.headline: Macy's Reports Strong Q2 2026 Results, Raises Guidance
items.summary: Macy's ($M) announced strong second-quarter 2026 results today, exceeding expectations across key metrics. Net sales increased 1.1% to $4.9 billion, and comparable sales rose 2.7%. The company also raised its full-year top- and bottom-line guidance.

items.headline: Nasdaq Ventures Invests $100M in Payward to Advance Tokenized Equities
items.summary: Nasdaq (NDAQ) announced an expansion of its relationship with Payward, the parent company of Kraken. Nasdaq Ventures is investing $100 million to advance the companies' work on Nasdaq Equity Tokens (NETs) and tokenized market infrastructure, with an expected launch of NETs in Q2 2027.
